name: nodejs.default_switch
description: Move the host's default node (NodeSource's nodejs package at /usr/bin/node) from one major to another: back up NodeSource's apt source (/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nodesource.list or nodesource.sources) and the installed nodejs version under /var/backups/node-default, point the source at deb.nodesource.com/node_TO.x, run apt-get update and install nodejs (downgrades allowed, config files kept), check /usr/bin/node --version is the new major, restart the running supervisor programs and systemd units whose command runs /usr/bin/node or a bare node, and 10 s later check each is RUNNING or active. On any failure it puts the source back, runs apt-get update and reinstalls the recorded nodejs version (or the newest the old source has) and restarts them again. It refuses unless the source names node_FROM.x alone and /usr/bin/node is major FROM from the nodejs package, and does nothing when both already say TO. Side installs under /opt/node are untouched.

from.description: The host's current Node.js major, such as 20.

to.description: The major to move it to, such as 22.

health_check: The helper puts the source and the recorded nodejs back unless /usr/bin/node is the new major and every program and unit that runs it is running 10 s later.
